title: The free tools — the connection to lawful free access
body: Outstanding free tools, legally solid, for books, textbooks, research and media. We are the CONNECTION to them — we host nothing and take nothing; we get you the most, free, through every lawful channel. Everything up to the line, nothing on it.
subject: the free tools

title: The line — lawful free access only
body: THE LINE — what we will and will not connect you to. We point ONLY to lawful free access: public-library lending, open licenses (Creative Commons / OER), the public domain, and fair use that has been upheld in court (as HathiTrust's was). We use everything UP TO that line and nothing on it. We do NOT point to Sci-Hub, Library Genesis, or any piracy — they lost in court, and we keep our hands clean (Romans 13:1; Matthew 22:21). The gift is real precisely because it is legal.
subject: the line
author: Matt Harris (the connection to free tools)
